_meta.title: gear-planner parser-gap corrections (U7.5)
_meta.note: gear-planner parser-gap corrections; affixes gear-planner under-parsed, sourced from the retired hand-verified base seed, spot-validated against the DDO wiki (Ophael's Cincture confirmed). The sanctioned minimal exception to single-source (KTD4).
_meta.sanctioned_exception: The ONLY sanctioned override of gear-planner's sole-authority rule (U7). Applied ADDITIVELY by build_dataset.py: gap affixes are APPENDED to the native affix block; an entry is skipped if the item already carries that (name,type) so it can never double-count.
_meta.scope: A genuine gap is a base-seed affix whose STAT is absent from gear-planner's native parse of that item ENTIRELY (not merely typed differently). Type-mismatches (base 'Accuracy +5' vs gear-planner Accuracy/Competence) and cross-name synonyms gear-planner already represents (Protection=Armor Class/Deflection, Shield=Armor Class/Shield, Natural Armor=Armor Class/Natural, Competence Healing Amplification=Healing Amplification/Competence, Spellcasting Implement=Universal Spell Power/Implement, Vitality=False Life/Vitality, Lifesealed=Negative Energy Absorption) are NOT gaps — restoring them would re-introduce the Insightful/Insight-class double-counts U4b/U7 correctly removed. Across all 89 base∪gear-planner collision items, exactly one item has a genuine gap: Ophael's Cincture.
_meta.ophaels_cincture: Wiki (Item:Ophael's_Cincture) category tags: Strength/Constitution/Dexterity/Intelligence/Wisdom/Charisma +15, Insightful +7 each, Quality +3 each — i.e. +15/+7/+3 to ALL ability scores. gear-planner captured only Deception (Enhancement +12, Insight +6) and Seeker (+15); it lacks every ability score. This overlay restores the 18 missing ability affixes (6 abilities x Enhancement 15 / Insight 7 / Quality 3). Deception/Seeker are NOT restored (gear-planner already has them).
